headline: Pakistan's NEPRA Raises Special Industrial Electricity Tariff to Rs25.30
summary: Pakistan's National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) revised the special industrial electricity tariff upward to Rs25.30 per unit despite internal dissent, alongside an additional fuel cost adjustment charge.
why: NEPRA regulates power generation, transmission, and distribution tariffs in Pakistan, directly impacting industrial operating costs.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Higher industrial power tariffs increase manufacturing costs across Pakistani commercial sectors.
